attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own published essay, stated in his voice and endorsed.

semantics.note: 'Needs to convert by the end of the year or it's effectively dead' is an unqualified conditional. The normalisation keeps the antecedent (no conversion by end of 2025) and the consequent. Reading the target as OpenAI is supported by context. 'Effectively dead' is undefined and arguably hyperbolic.

contract.note: Reading the target as OpenAI and 'convert' as completing the for-profit recapitalization fits the context. The result turns on the antecedent's status, not on how 'effectively dead' is read.

evidence.note: OpenAI's own disclosure, dated 2025-10-28, says the recapitalization was complete. It shows the antecedent (no conversion by end of 2025) did not occur. It is evidence of the condition, not of the outcome, so it is context rather than contradiction. It is a company statement about itself.

output.rationale: This is a conditional forecast. The only evidence, an OpenAI disclosure dated 2025-10-28, indicates the recapitalization was completed before the end of 2025, so the antecedent did not happen. Under policy, a conditional whose antecedent did not occur is not scored. The packet's 'contradicts' label is wrong: the item bears on the condition, not on whether OpenAI was effectively dead.
